title: FPP TAB Bridge
description: FPP TAB Bridge syncs Fake Player Plugin (FPP) bot data from MySQL into your Velocity/TAB network, giving you shared bot counts, linked tablist, synced skins, and custom placeholders across servers.
body:
# **FPP TAB Bridge**

**FPP TAB Bridge** is a bridge plugin for Velocity networks that connects Fake Player Plugin bot data to TAB-style network displays.

It reads bot information directly from MySQL and keeps fake players synced across your network with:

- stable identities
- consistent skins
- shared bot counts
- combined player count placeholders

This makes it easier to display bots in tab-related systems without relying on each backend server to manage them separately.

## Features
- Syncs Fake Player Plugin bot data from MySQL
- Bridges fake players into Velocity/TAB environments
- Keeps bot identities stable across servers
- Supports synced bot skins using stored texture/signature data
###  Adds custom placeholders for:
- total bots
- combined player counts
- Designed for multi-server networks
- Helps TAB and related display systems reflect fake players more accurately

## What it is for

This plugin is built for networks where fake players need to appear more consistently across multiple servers. It helps centralize fake player data and makes cross-server bot displays cleaner and easier to manage.
